project_type: Flutter/Dart mobile app with Firebase backend, Android-only, SQLite local database
build_system: Flutter SDK 3.41.6, Dart 3.11.4, pubspec.yaml dependency management
test_framework: Built-in flutter test (test/widget_test.dart exists but minimal coverage)
build_command: flutter build apk --debug (for testing) or flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --shrink --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/debug-info (for release)
test_command: flutter analyze (linting only, no automated tests currently)
verification_instructions: For each feature: (1) Run flutter analyze to ensure zero errors/warnings, (2) Run flutter build apk --debug to verify compilation, (3) Manual testing on Android device or emulator with test scenarios documented in each FEAT, (4) Verify no crashes and expected behavior matches acceptance criteria
snapshot_or_generated_files: None that require checking in. Build artifacts go to build/ (gitignored). Screenshots and debug exports go to docs/debug/
environment_constraints: Windows development environment with PowerShell. No automated tests exist currently. Firebase Remote Config required for AI features. Local testing uses debug mode with test data loaded via 'Try Demo' or 'Load Demo Data' features.
contribution_requirements: Code must maintain backward compatibility with v3.3.9. Follow existing service patterns (services/ directory). New screens go in screens/. Database changes require migration logic in db_service.dart's _ensureColumns(). All new features must work offline-first (local SQLite, optional Firebase sync). Maintain existing code style and patterns.
key_patterns: Services pattern: Static methods in XxxService classes. Database: DBService.getDB() returns SQLite Database, queries use sqflite package. Screens: StatefulWidget with _ScreenNameState. Navigation: MaterialPageRoute push. Widgets: Custom widgets in widgets/ directory. AI integration: Uses LLMService with multiple providers (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, etc.). Currency formatting: CurrencyService.formatNumber(). Event notifications: EventBus for cross-screen updates. Notifications: flutter_local_notifications for push. File operations: path_provider for app directories, share_plus for exports.
directory_structure: lib/ contains: models/ (data models), screens/ (UI screens - 45 files), services/ (business logic - 37 files), widgets/ (reusable components). Database schema v14 with 26 tables in SQLite. Firebase used for auth, remote config, and optional Firestore sync. Assets in assets/. Documentation in docs/. Test files in test/.
